## Teaching points

1. An adnexal collection plus systemic illness changes uncomplicated PID into an inpatient problem.
2. Begin a complete parenteral regimen, including the required organism coverage, and review drainage with gynecology.
3. Ongoing shock, generalized peritonitis or deterioration requires urgent reassessment for rupture or uncontrolled infection.
